newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS rises 7 pct on H1 result jump.
newsitem.headline: PGS rises 7 pct on H1 result jump.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian offshore services and seismic company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) rose sharply on Wednesday after the company posted a 53 percent rise in pre-tax profits in the first half 1997.

At 1220 GMT PGS was almost seven percent up at 395 crowns in trade of 26.4 million crowns. The stock rose to a high at 400 crowns, a jump of 30 crowns from Tuesday's close, after the figures were released.
PGS attributed the profit increase in the first six months to improved operating efficiency, strong sales in the three-dimension multi-client sector and generally good market conditions.
